author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a stadium drum with a wide flat roof on a rim band that flares out, a wall tapering in to the ground braced by a zigzag of struts, and a ground line; follows the reference's silhouette. The rejected drawing (semicircular dome over an inverted trapezoid) and earlier attempts here (attempts/) read as a basket.
omissions: The reference's two light rays above the roof and its separate base band are omitted: neither can keep 8 units of clearance in the 32-unit height.
lucide_reference: No Lucide stadium; plain polygon construction.
